channel.title: james-ccg - updates
channel.description: Changes to the tools and the site. Small, occasional, and written by hand.

item.title: A full end-to-end test, and everything it found fixed
item.description: Every page tested on phone, tablet and desktop. The homepage no longer runs into the screen edges on phones, the shrine stacks its windows on narrow screens, the idle screensaver stays off when switched off, the Excel converter and Discord renamer explain themselves, and there is a real 404 page.

item.title: Background Cropper: preview zoom, Steam's footer, and a dozen fixes
item.description: Zoom the whole mock profile at 50-125% while slicing a background, every showcase previewed in Steam's real 632px panel, the avatar frame back at Steam's size, and the page now wears Steam's footer.

item.title: The Cropper wears the Dying Light 2 profile theme
item.description: The mock profile now matches the real one: Dying Light 2 background art, its animated avatar frame, and the Game Profile theme's own colours.

item.title: A Windows 98 shrine, an arcade, and Puck
item.description: A Natsuki Subaru shrine on a draggable Windows 98 desktop, with a Return by Death mini game; an arcade with a pet and a daily sticker roll; Puck in the corner and an optional cursor pack.

item.title: The homepage is a place now, not a CV
item.description: Rebuilt the front page: a proper identity block, every link as an 88x31 button carrying its real logo, a theme switcher, and a button of my own you can take.

item.title: Background Cropper: a Workshop Showcase is five slots, not one
item.description: Slicing a background for a Workshop Showcase now cuts all five slots at their real positions instead of one wide piece, and the showcase geometry was re-measured against a live Steam profile.

item.title: Steam Artwork Cropper
item.description: Crops Featured, Artwork, Workshop and profile Background images to Steam's exact pixel sizes, entirely in the browser, against a pixel-accurate recreation of the profile page.
